findings.suggested_fix: Replace “hampir tidak sanggup melanjutkan hidup” with “hampir tidak sanggup melanjutkan” or “hampir tidak sanggup terus maju.” The source says she could barely go on; it does not specify that she could barely continue living.
findings.translation_quote: sampai-sampai hampir tidak sanggup melanjutkan hidup

findings.source_quote: “to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “bersikap sederhana” with “bersikap terkendali” or “menahan diri” to convey “temperate” in this context.
findings.translation_quote: “bersikap tenang dan terkendali dalam roh; bersikap sederhana dan tidak dikuasai perasaan.”
